name: Magnetic Vacuum Suction Cup Phone Holder (360° Rotating)
shortDescription: Double-sided holder: magnetic on metal, vacuum suction on glass and tiles.
description: A 360° rotating phone holder with a magnetic face for MagSafe phones and a vacuum suction cup that grips glass, tiles and car surfaces. Swap between desk, mirror, car and gym use in seconds.
highlights: Sticks to glass, tiles and metal

specifications.label: Compatibility
specifications.value: MagSafe phones or phones with a metal plate
